description: K8s reap hang root cause (warren-c433): after pod-exit terminal, streamWithSignal's finally awaited iterator.return() on the pod-log async generator, which parks forever on an empty queue with no follow EOF — run stuck 'running' indefinitely and the in-pod finalize-intent poll deadlocked (warren only parks intent at reap, reap never ran). Lesson: any 'drain then abort' path over a provider stream needs a hard time bound.
resolution: boundedTeardown races iterator.return() against 5s (DEFAULT_STREAM_TEARDOWN_MS); finalize() parks intent when terminal observed via pod exit; watchdog-reconcile.ts force-finalizes running rows whose pod is terminal past WARREN_RUN_TERMINAL_RECONCILE_GRACE_MS (120s default).

title: Stay on GKE Autopilot; fix SSD quota via boot-disk class, not quota increases
rationale: SSD_TOTAL_GB (500GB us-west1) was 455GB used with only 55GB PVCs — ~400GB is Autopilot node boot disks (100GB pd-balanced each; pd-balanced counts against SSD quota). Quota bumps auto-denied twice (1000, 750; 48h cooldown). DISKS_TOTAL_GB pool is 4TB with 0 used, so a custom ComputeClass with storage.bootDiskType pd-standard decouples scale-up from SSD quota entirely.

description: K8s auto-plan-run tracker durability gap (warren-486c): in-pod finalize pushes the run branch before control-plane applyCloneDeltas. applyCloneDeltas then commits merged .seeds bodies only in the host project clone and does not push or expose that commit as the plan-run ref. auto_plan_run may be created against this host-only state; the next project refresh resets to origin/main, discards the mirror commit, and fresh child pods cannot find their seed IDs (production plnr_4tn7zxf11crp; dangling f68ec53e; repeated plnr_a6km12v631hf/plnr_79qtd1vc179a).
resolution: Fix under warren-486c: make merged tracker rows durable and reachable from the exact child-clone ref before emitting auto_plan_run_created; skip auto-dispatch if durability fails.

name: K8s mirror durability push before auto-plan-run dispatch
description: warren-486c fix: on the K8s reap path (workspacePath===null), applyK8sCloneDeltas (src/runs/reap/clone-apply.ts) now applies the finalize mirror bodies to the host clone THEN, when the run carries auto_plan_run frontmatter, pushes that 'chore(warren): mirror state' commit to origin/<project.defaultBranch> (HEAD:<ref>, fast-forward, never forced) via pushCloneDeltasToOrigin BEFORE auto-dispatch. defaultBranch is the exact ref child pods clone (auto-plan-run's dispatchOnePlan sets plan-run ref=defaultBranch). A failed/rejected push sets state.mirrorDurabilityFailed, which makes autoDispatchStep (pipeline.ts) emit auto_plan_run_skipped{reason:mirror_durability_failed} and create NO plan-run/DB row/auto_plan_run_created event. Emits reap.clone_deltas_pushed on success; folds push failure into reap errors[] as step=clone_apply_push. LocalProvider path (workspacePath!==null) is byte-identical (no origin push). fakeExec gained failPush to fail only git push. Regression: src/runs/reap/run.k8s.auto-plan-run.test.ts.
